name: Cloudgate Events
description: Event discovery, ticket sales, QR admission and an organiser back office with Cloudgate payments, media, email and themes.
features: Event discovery and detailed event pages
Wallet checkout and verified ticket issuance
Cloudgate identity, email, media, logging and theme presets
Website analytics in the back office: views, sessions, visitors, pages, countries, traffic sources and devices from Cloudgate Web App Insights

summary: Organisers are responsible for event details, capacity, content rights and admission policies.
Payments and full refunds are processed through Cloudgate Wallet.
Cancellation stops sales and voids tickets; organisers must review and refund paid bookings.

compliance.label: Event and content rights confirmed
compliance.text: I am authorised to organise these events and use their content and media.

compliance.label: Sandbox booking and admission verified
compliance.text: I have verified ticket sales, payment confirmation, refunds, check-in and email delivery in hosted sandbox.
